question: Who won the Gold Mercury Award 2025 for promoting peace and sustainability?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Dalai Lama.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Dalai Lama was awarded the Gold Mercury Award 2025 for his contributions to peace, non-violence, and environmental stewardship.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **The award recognizes Dalai Lama's role in fostering global peace, compassion, and sustainability on his 90th birthday.**
 
• Gold Mercury International, a global governance think tank, presents the award to world leaders, pioneers, and organizations promoting global cooperation.
 
• The Dalai Lama’s philosophy emphasizes the interdependence of humanity and nature, advocating for ecological preservation.
 
• The award ceremony will be held on March 31, 2025, in Dharamsala, India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Gold Mercury International__

 __
 
• Founded in 1961, it is a global think tank dedicated to advancing peace and international cooperation.
 
• Its Gold Mercury Awards® recognize excellence in visionary governance and diplomacy.
 
 
 
• Past Award Recipients__
 __
 
• U.S. Presidents Ronald Reagan & Gerald Ford for nuclear disarmament efforts.
 
• President Anwar Sadat of Egypt for Middle East peace efforts.
 
• Prof. Robert Gallo for discovering HIV as the cause of AIDS.
 
• Organizations like UNICEF and the Red Cross for humanitarian work.
 
 
 
• Tibetan Plateau - "Third Pole"__
 
 
• Holds the largest freshwater reserves outside the Arctic and Antarctic.
 
• Source of Asia's major rivers, critical for global ecological balance.
